headline: Set $2,450.00 monthly rent for 12 months in Ardolino v Quinnipiac University case; continued five cases, dismissed three.
summary: Rent was set at $2,450.00 per month for 12 months in the Ardolino v Quinnipiac University case, with Commissioner Molina abstaining. Five cases were continued, and two of them will be revisited on November 5, 2026. Three cases were dismissed.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 3, 2026 regular meeting.
Continued FRC-260723-J Vincent v Seramonte LLC after a continuance was requested.
Continued FRC-260807-G Jean-Francois v Seramonte LLC to monitor extermination efforts, to be revisited November 5, 2026.
Continued FRC-260821-W Canieso v Seramonte LLC after a continuance was requested.
Continued FRC-260825-E-Pazmino v Broadmoor Apartments after the landlord's first continuance request was granted.
Continued FRC-260906-A Warren v Garces due to the tenant's absence, to be revisited November 5, 2026.
Set rent at $2,450.00 per month for 12 months, October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027, in FRC-260910-S Ardolino v Quinnipiac University; Commissioner Molina abstained.
Resumed prior agreed rent beginning October 1, 2026, and dismissed FRC-260421-K Harris v Parmar.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Fair Rent Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
6:00 PM, October 1, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
fairrent@Hamden.com 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 
 
  1. Commissioner Roll Call  
  Chair Commissioner Cunningham called the meeting to order at 6:07 P.M. 
Commissioner Amy Molina present 
Commissioner Chanelle Goldson present 
Commissioner Greta Johnson present 
Quorum established 
Attorney Tim Lee present 
Director Karen Bivens present 
Commissioner Vice Chair Conte Robinson absent 
Commissioner Jacob Marrandino absent 
Commissioner Antwan Nedd absent 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 
 
  1. FRC-260807-G Jean-Francois V Seramonte LLC 
FRC-260904-J-Princevalli V Seramonte LLC 
FRC-260906-A Warren V Garces 
FRC-260910-S Ardolino V Quinnipiac University  
  
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. Fair Rent Commission Regular Meeting September 3, 2026_Minutes_Preview (2).pdf  
  Motion Passed. 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No Public Comment 
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 
 
  1. FRC-260723-J Vincent v Seramonte LLC continuance requested.
2. FRC-260821-W Canieso v Seramonte LLC continuance requested .  
  
 
  3. FRC-260825-E-Pazmino V Broadmoor Apartments - Landlord requested 
continuance.  
  
 
  4. Commissioner Jennifer Paradis– Departure from the Commission  
  
 
6. CASES TO BE HEARD   
 
 
 1. FRC-260723-J Vincent v Seramonte LLC 
       
  Motion: Continuance was requested and granted. Motioned by Commission Chair 
Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner Molina. 
 2. FRC-260807-G Jean-Francois V Seramonte LLC 
       
  Alex Jean-Francois, tenant, was sworn in by Commission Chair Cunningham and 
gave testimony. Attorney Reckmeyer, the landlord’s representative, provided 
testimony. 
Motion: The case has been continued to monitor the progress of extermination efforts. 
The Commission will revisit the matter at its next regular meeting, scheduled for 
November 5, 2026. Motioned by Commission Chair Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner 
Molina. 
 3. FRC-260821-W Canieso v Seramonte LLC 
       
  Motion: Continuance was requested and granted. Motioned by Commission Chair 
Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner Molina. 
 4. FRC-260825-E-Pazmino V Broadmoor Apartments 
       
  Motion: 1st continuance requested by landlord was requested and granted. Motioned 
by Commission Chair Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner Molina. 
 5. FRC-260904-J-Princevalli V Seramonte LLC 
       
  Lynette Princevalli, tenant, was sworn in by Commission Chair Cunningham and gave 
testimony. Attorney Reckmeyer, the landlord’s representative, provided testimony. 
Motion: Case Dismissed. Motioned by Commission Chair Cunningham, 2nd 
Commissioner Molina. 
 6. FRC-260906-A Warren V Garces 
       
  Shelita Warren, tenant, was absent. Cesar Garces, landlord was present. 
Motion: The case has been continued due to the tenant’s absence. The Commission 
will revisit the matter at its next regular meeting, scheduled for November 5, 2026. 
Motioned by Commission Chair Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner Goldson. 
 7. FRC-260910-S Ardolino V Quinnipiac University 
       
  Florence Ardolino, tenant, was sworn in by Commission Chair Cunningham and 
provided testimony. Keith Woodward, Quinnipiac University representative, was also 
sworn in by Commission Chair Cunningham and provided testimony.
Motion: The rent for the unit is set at $2,450.00 per month for a period of 12 months, 
effective October 1, 2026, through September 30, 2027. Motioned by Commission 
Chair Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner Johnson. Commissioner Molina abstained 
from voting on the matter. 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 No Excecutive Session 
8. REPORTS   
 No Reports 
9. OLD BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. FRC-260704-C Vaccianna V Seramonte  
  Motion: Case Dismissed. Motioned by Commission Chair Cunningham, 2nd 
Commissioner Molina. 
  2. FRC-260421-K Harris V Parmar  
  Motion: Rent resumes at the prior agreed rate beginning October 1, 2026. Case 
dismissed. Motioned by Commission Chair Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner Goldson. 
10. NEW BUSINESS   
 No New Business 
11. ADJOURNMENT   
 The meeting was adjourned at 9:11 p.m.
